summary.text: Dave Parke is the Republican candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democratic incumbent Jake Fitisemanu.
A healthcare executive, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he would focus on reducing regulations, inflation and affordable housing in West Valley City.

paragraphs.text: Dave Parke was born in Ogden, Utah, and earned a high school diploma from Weber High School, an associate degree from Weber State University in 1987, a bachelor's degree from Southern Utah University in 1990 and a graduate degree from the University of Phoenix in 1997.
His career experience includes working as a healthcare executive.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been affiliated with the Home Care & Hospice Association of Utah for 15 years and is its incoming president.
Parke said his key messages are reducing unneeded government regulations, easing the effects of inflation and promoting affordable housing for local families.
He also said West Valley City is too often treated as an afterthought.
